title: Not So Bummed (UPDATED)
text:
I was so excited to open my shirt, but the print is bad quality. The color is kind of faded and picture is a bit blurry. The design is still cute, I will probably wait to see how the quality is next month and if it’s still disappointing I will just return it and cancel my subscription.

Update: the second shirt has arrived and the print is so much better! I’m loving both designs so far. Looking forward to next month!
label: positive
